comments: Reviewed source composition, source-foot pivots and cell order. Supplemental poses are reviewed proposals, not added animation states.
Exact canvas, stamp and rule timings retained. Native cleanup and plate slicing bake once in the renderer.
geometry: planks(), supports(), landing(); 13 supports including endpoints. Only selected interior decks lift. Surface stays at p.y irrespective of illustrated thickness.
mapping_basis: Visual review of source sheets and cleanup notes, 2026-10-15

size_basis: 24×10 tile, top-left at plank (x,y); repeated every 24 px. Rule widths 232 (bottom/top), 72 (lifts), 140 (fixed), 36 px deck spacing. Final tile currently can overhang rule width; do not treat it as support.
timing: One tile; lift triangular track uses phase=(elapsed/2+seed%80+deck×11)%80, 160-tick phase cycle (planks()).
